text:
maria: Heads up — seeing an odd autoscaler oscillation in the us-west GPU pools for the last 30m. Queue depth spikes 3-4x then drops, scaler spins up nodes then they drain, repeat. Posting graphs and the alert rule i think is too twitchy.
ajay: @maria can you drop the grafana link and the prom query/rule?
maria: grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/pool-queue?orgId=1&from=now-30m
```
# Prom query we're tracking
sum by(pool) (increase(inference_queue_length[1m]))
```
Alert rule snippet: `expr: sum by(pool) (increase(inference_queue_length[1m])) > 50` for: `1m` severity: `page`
maria: Also noticed average batch_size collapse when the queue spikes -> throughput tanked.
kai: saw a similar pattern in asia earlier today. suspect client burstiness + a model fallback to a larger model increased CPU/GPU work per request. :thinking_face:
ops-bot: autoscaler event: scale_up pool=gpu-large region=us-west from=4 to=8 reason="queue > threshold" ts=1768123400
liz: two quick mitigations i recommend: (1) increase the alert evaluation window to 3m and feed a moving_average(5m) into the scaling decision, (2) add minimum headroom 15% on pool config so we don't scale to zero headroom.
ajay: +1 on debounce. don't want the scaler to react to 30s blips. maybe `for: 3m` or a step-debounce on the alert.
temi: I can patch the prom rule and test on canary pool `gpu-canary` first.
maria: please do canary. finance already flagged that last night's bursts doubled GPU hours for us-west. need to prove we don't regress cost.
kai: on the network side, noticed increased TCP retransmits to some model servers during the windows — opening net-team ticket, could be client-side retries causing bursts.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: prometheus-rule-change by temi -> staging -> smoke tests
liz: for immediate safety set autoscaler cooldown to 5m and cap max_scale_by=2 to avoid huge single jumps while we tune.
ajay: i'll update the runbook: steps for queue oscillation = reduce alert sensitivity, add headroom, check net retransmits, look for client retry spikes, validate batch sizing.
maria: action items: temi patch rule to canary, ajay update runbook, kai open net ticket, liz set temp cooldown. reconvene in 30m. :eyes: 
temi: pushing PR now: https://git.internal/repo/infra/ops/123 (prom rule change, add moving_avg and for:3m)
ops-bot: PR merged to staging at 1768123580
maria: initial canary looks promising — immediate oscillation amplitude reduced. still monitoring.
lar: (note: not part of participants list) -- ignore
maria: keeping thread for notes. if canary holds we'll roll to prod and file a brief incident note. if not, we'll escalate.
